messages.subject: Error for new column in Observation layer
parts:
Hi all, 
I encountered an issue related to analysis in Distance 7.3 version. I am trying to add new column, for specie) in the observation layer. Attached you can have a look on the print screen of it. 
I would appreciate an answer from anyone who encountered and solved it. 

All the best,
Marian

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error for new column in Observation layer
parts:
Good morning Marian.

The message says Distance thinks some other program might be accessing the data you are trying to alter.  I've had this happen to me on occasion.  I have found that a solution is to close the project, close Distance, then reopen the project and the issue is resolved.  Distance merely gets confused whether it has access to the database file you wish to alter.

If this is not an adequate solution, the alternative would be to create a data file containing your data and use the import wizard rather than entering the data manually into Distance.

Let me know which solution works for you.
